# Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk

**Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk** is a healthcare cluster (sundhedsklynge) operating within [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] in Denmark [^src5]. It is one of the local organizational units monitored by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP) to evaluate and improve the clinical treatment of [[atrieflimren|atrial fibrillation]] across the Danish healthcare system [^src1].

The cluster is specifically noted for its performance on national clinical quality indicators. In the 2024 "Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark" (AFDK) report, Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk was highlighted as one of the health clusters that successfully met the national standard for Indicator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy for newly diagnosed patients, achieving a result of 90.8% [^src1]. 

Beyond initial treatment, the cluster's clinical practices and patient outcomes are comprehensively tracked across multiple metrics. These include 1-year, 2-year, and 5-year anticoagulation treatment coverage [^src2] [^src3], the frequency of annual P-creatinine measurements for patients on DOAC therapy [^src4], and the incidence of severe bleeding and heart failure within one year of a new diagnosis [^src6] [^src7]. Furthermore, Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk is included in national geographic distributions mapping the incidence of ischemic stroke ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) among atrial fibrillation patients at the cluster level [^src4]. This extensive data collection supports hierarchical quality improvement strategies, allowing regional and local authorities to benchmark performance and identify variations in clinical practice [^src2].
